title: Long confirmation runs (100k and 200k steps) of the validation-best E016, E017, E018 configurations and the complex_a / complex_both controls
note: the 'confirm' stage of the E015-E018 prompt (part 6); a separate experiment folder because AGENTS.md requires a new E-number and output path for every new run
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
family_selection: for each family the (configuration, lr branch) with the best mean best_val_reduction over seeds in its results/*.csv; written to results/confirm_choice.json when the stage is built; a family without results is skipped with a message
length_note: const_1e-3: only the 200k run; the 100k point is read from its curve (with a constant lr the first 100k steps are identical to a 100k run, checked bit-for-bit in E010 resume tests). best_e010 decays over the run, so 100k and 200k are separate runs
phases_note: multi-phase schemes keep their structure with lengths scaled to the total (E017 frozen: half / half; E018 layerwise: Ns layer phases + fine-tuning at lr / 3, proportional)
best_e010: experiments/E010_lr_schedule_study/results/stage3_choice.json: 'a' for complex_a and the physics families, 'both' for complex_both; for the physics families c_mult 30 only if best_e010_cm30 beat best_e010_cm1 on validation for that configuration in its experiment, otherwise c_mult 1

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.plateau: as E011: improvement of the smoothed (10k window) validation reduction over the last 50k steps < 0.2 p.p.; otherwise 'plateau not reached within N steps' and y_inf only as a rough estimate
rule_draft.long_vs_short: the 200k result is reported next to the 20k/40k result of the same configuration in its experiment; no verdict beyond the plateau
